titulo: Coverd bowl in the shape of a pomegranate
material: Porcelain with relief decoration, painted in underglaze cobalt blue and overglaze polychrome enamels (Jingdezhen ware)
dimensoes: H. w/ cover: 4 1/2 in. (11.4 cm); Diam. 7 1/4 in. (18.4 cm)
descricao: Covered bowl from China, Qing dynasty (1644-1911).
